## Ingredients

 - One can white beans 
 - 2 cloves garlic
 - 1-2 tbs of tomato paste, adobo sauce, etc
 - Fresh tomatoes, as many as you want
 - Bread
 - Rosemary ground into a smooth powder
 - Hot sauce

## Instructions

Cook the garlic and the tomatoes until the garlic is fragrant, before it burns. 

Add beans. Add ground rosemary (so you aren't having things that would get caught in your teeth). 

Cover and cook with a little water to the point that you want (do you want the tomatoes to burst? Do you want them still firm?). 

Serve with bread and hot sauce.
